newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end easier, but rally seen resuming.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end easier, but rally seen resuming.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Belgian shares end easier on the last day of the forward market account in lower than average volume, but analysts see the bull trend remaining firmly in place over the medium to long term. Consolidation could not be ruled out in the immediate term, some added.
* Bel-20 index .BFX ends 7.64 points or 0.37 pct lower at 2,080.94, nearly three bln Bfr worth of Belgian shares traded.
* Chemicals stock Solvay ends 2.3 percent lower at 21,450, continuing to correct downwards after sharp rise in January and 1996 preliminary results last week which disappointed many in the market.
